description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing user notifications, including fetching, marking as read, and creating notifications.

methods.name: GET /notifications
methods.description: Fetches notifications for the authenticated user, optionally filtering for unread only.

methods.name: PATCH /notifications/:notificationId/read
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read.

methods.name: PATCH /notifications/read-all
methods.description: Marks all notifications for the user as read.

methods.name: POST /notifications
methods.description: Creates a new notification, restricted to admins or the user themselves.
